{"summary":"Very customers report Prime’s promised 2‑day shipping is frequently delayed, often taking 3‑4 days. [#tk_2868365]
Many users feel trapped into Prime, unable to cancel or opt‑out after signing up. [#tk_2061568]
Repeated notifications claim on‑time delivery, yet items arrive late or are canceled. [#tk_2693909]
Prime members experience missed delivery attempts and lack of proactive communication from support. [#tk_2621074]
Overall dissatisfaction has led some loyal customers to threaten canceling Prime and discouraging others. [#tk_594545]"}
